svg.title: Dose-response curves of a signaling cascade
svg.desc: Normalized response against ligand concentration on a log scale for receptor occupancy alone, a cascade of two non-cooperative steps, which is shifted to lower doses but not steeper, and a cascade of two cooperative steps, which is steeper.
svg.text: Signaling cascades: shifting versus sharpening the response
ligand concentration, in units of the receptor K_d (log scale)
